name: Tyler Stahl
headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer and Applied AI Developer
summary: Full-stack software engineer with experience shipping React/TypeScript and Laravel applications at nonprofit scale, plus hands-on applied AI systems work.

featuredProjects.name: Development Knowledge Vault
featuredProjects.problem: AI coding agents on new projects rediscover the same deploy, auth, eval, and security practices instead of reusing distilled patterns from prior agent and product repos.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a Vercel-hosted MCP server that exposes markdown engineering patterns as tools (`list_patterns`, `get_pattern`), with dual auth on one URL—Clerk OAuth for cloud clients and an optional shared-secret Bearer for local/curl—so Cursor, Gemini Spark, and other MCP clients can pull operational preferences and prior solutions at request time.
outcomes: Production MCP endpoint serving a curated pattern corpus (deploy, auth, evals, PII, multi-agent, YAML SOT, and related practices).
Dual-acceptance auth documented and shipped so the same URL works for OAuth clients and Bearer-configured IDE/curl without smart surface detection.
Personal Cursor skill (`knowledge-vault`) that steers agents to query the vault before inventing process.
featuredProjects.portfolioBlurb: An MCP server that serves distilled engineering patterns to AI coding agents, so a new project reuses prior deploy, auth, and eval practices instead of rediscovering them.

featuredProjects.name: InSummery.AI
featuredProjects.problem: Family scheduling information lives in messy emails, texts, and PDFs; calendar apps assume tidy manual entry and do not detect multi-child childcare gaps or real-time disruptions with a human still in control.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a Google ADK 2.0 multi-agent concierge that masks PII, triages and extracts schedule data, pauses below 80% confidence for HITL clarification, maintains a multi-child schedule matrix with absolute/relative gap analysis, and syncs disruptions to Google Calendar—shipped as a Kaggle + Google 5-Day AI Agents Intensive Consult-track capstone.
outcomes: Capstone writeup published on Kaggle for the vibecoding agents competition.
Public demo app and GitHub repository with CLI and Firebase web modes.
Deterministic eval harness with absolute quality gates (e.g., 90% triager accuracy, 80% workflow pass rate) and baseline regression tracking.
featuredProjects.portfolioHeadline: LLM Reasoning with Human Decisions & PII Masking
featuredProjects.portfolioBlurb: A multi-agent scheduling concierge that masks PII before inference and pauses for a human when its confidence drops below 80%, turning messy family email into a reconciled calendar.

featuredProjects.name: OpenClaw Multi-Agent Market Intelligence Ecosystem
featuredProjects.problem: Long-running agentic market-research tasks lose state and context without durable memory and governance when synthesizing fragmented commodity and market data.
featuredProjects.solution: Built an autonomous research framework on OpenClaw with specialized agents (data pull, profitability analysis, dashboard UI, orchestrator), SQLite persistence, Python ETL workers, and HITL approval gates—applied to real-world and World of Warcraft commodity markets.
outcomes: Durable multi-turn agent memory across interrupted research tasks.
Structured extraction of market data into relational formats.
Human validation before high-stakes database commits.
Faster market-context decision making in the pilot domain (self-reported ~15% profit lift in interview notes; medium/low confidence).
featuredProjects.portfolioBlurb: An autonomous research framework whose agents keep durable memory across interrupted tasks and stop for human approval before any high-stakes database commit.

featuredProjects.name: Cognitive Bridge: AI Personality Alignment
featuredProjects.problem: Human-AI collaboration can suffer when agent personality is poorly matched to the user, and prototypes need a path from AI Studio into secured production backends.
featuredProjects.solution: Built an OCEAN-based personality alignment prototype in Google AI Studio, then productionized it on Firebase Cloud Functions with Firestore memory, Firebase Auth, Vertex AI, and Pydantic-validated structured Gemini outputs.
outcomes: Personality map generation from a brief user interview.
Demonstration of aligned and unaligned chat responses for evaluation.
Migrated prototype to a serverless Python backend with auth-scoped endpoints and durable Firestore memory.
featuredProjects.portfolioBlurb: An OCEAN-based personality alignment engine that tunes an agent's voice to the person it is talking to, taken from an AI Studio prototype to an auth-scoped serverless backend.

featuredProjects.name: AgentOS: Chief of Staff Agent
featuredProjects.problem: Complex long-running workflows need reliable orchestration with mandatory human checkpoints.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a multi-agent orchestrator with the Cursor Agent SDK, modular subagents, and HITL handoffs for evaluation and testing stages.
outcomes: Modular subagent design for evaluation and testing workflows.
Mandatory human approval handoffs at critical stages.
featuredProjects.portfolioBlurb: A multi-agent orchestrator with modular subagents and mandatory human checkpoints, built so long-running workflows can be paused and inspected rather than trusted blindly.

featuredProjects.name: Stack Overlord
featuredProjects.problem: A merge can succeed in GitHub while its post-merge deployment fails silently (credentials, quotas, environment config), leaving production stale with no clear notification signal—built for OpenAI Build Week 2026's Developer Tools track under tight hackathon constraints, primarily via Codex/GPT-5.6.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a Next.js/TypeScript command center that ingests signed GitHub Actions webhooks into a durable Postgres/Drizzle ledger (GitHub stays the source of truth for pass/fail), diagnoses failures with the OpenAI Responses API (GPT-5.6) using evidence citations, confidence levels, and verification steps, alerts Slack, and ships a deterministic credential-free demo mode so judges can exercise the whole flow.
outcomes: Signed, idempotent GitHub webhook ingestion into a Postgres ledger, with GitHub kept as sole source of truth for workflow status.
GPT-5.6 failure diagnosis with evidence citations, confidence levels, and ordered verification steps, plus Slack failure alerts.
Deterministic, credential-free demo mode with fixture replay so OpenAI Build Week judges could evaluate the product without GitHub/OpenAI credentials.
Responsive (desktop/mobile) dashboard covered by Playwright and Vitest tests.
featuredProjects.portfolioBlurb: A CI/CD command center that catches silent post-merge deployment failures—ingesting signed GitHub webhooks into a durable Postgres ledger and diagnosing failures with cited, confidence-scored GPT-5.6 analysis that never overrides GitHub's own pass/fail verdict.
